issues.label: Agent-native semantic GPU debugger and profiler
Deterministic CPU semantic simulator and virtual GPU runtime

capabilities.label: Rust ownership and result flow
capabilities.detail: rustc remains the only Rust borrow checker: it enforces moves, borrows, lifetimes, visibility, and local typestate. Fe2O3 extends those rules with sealed non-Clone GPU capabilities and workload-neutral cross-invocation verification. Typed kernels may return KernelResult and use ?, while the macro emits a private unit-ABI entry wrapper and the compiler retains the helper's real MIR. Err ends only the current invocation and is not a host-visible error channel.

capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The fixed eight-pass workload-neutral pre-lowering sequence verifies rooted tensor-layout composition, ranked bounds and checked machine-index arithmetic, atomic legality, cross-invocation race freedom, complete hierarchy ownership, barrier and SIMT collective protocol convergence, workgroup-memory initialization/publication, and semantic refinement. The semantic stage now fails closed on unproved loop progress and on changed numerical operator trees without an error theorem. A separate compiler-supplied target precondition checks launch geometry, static LDS use, and origin-bound host allocation size and alignment before the same eight passes; it grants no launch authority. Compiler-derived tensor roots connect producers to operand and accumulator consumers; incompatible ABI flow and producer joins are compile-time errors. Every diagnostic includes a concrete repair or states the missing proof obligation. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Unified production route
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust enters one production architecture: semantic MIR is projected into ranked PLIRON, checked normalization and the fixed verification sequence run there, and the admitted result is carried into canonical Kernel IR V7 and formal-memory admission. Alternate host applications and the source-first simulator route are not current compiler paths. Earlier MI300X measurements remain historical observations at their original commits, not current launch commands or authority for this unpinned compiler state. Unsupported effects, witnesses, and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: The sole fixed eight-stage analysis route shares closed CFG, SSA, uniformity, sparse index, Presburger, provenance, memory-order, SIMT, and bounded invocation facts without recognizing a workload. Analysis-only stages are protected by a context-wide mutation-attempt epoch, exact structural checkpoints, and sealed report custody. Independent raw replay is Complete only for the admitted single-block static bounded-access fragment: invocation dimensions must be finite and unique; at most one execution layout is allowed, and any retained layout must exactly match the active dimension inventory. All extents and index operations must be supported, and checked u64 replay must stay within its resource cap. Nonempty tensor-layout replay remains Incomplete until external roots have explicit operational-SSA provenance. Raw checked tiled and row-striped markers fail closed with FE2O3-RACE-002; generic explicit affine and bounded Presburger maps remain supported. Canonical single-entry multi-block forwarding loops require a positive constant step plus source-width and u64 no-wrap proofs. Authenticated MIR projection may emit the value-producing kernel.index_unsigned_cast only when the exact source range makes its unsigned-width conversion value-preserving and the exact source recurrence has been replayed. One production transformation folds exact preceding index constants after independent exact typed replay, retaining one input clone and moving the validated output through private receipt custody. The current production matrix reaches FE2O3-RACE-002 before KIR, so it carries no KIR or hardware claim.

capabilities.label: Safe Rust functional references
capabilities.detail: The published compiler baseline runs one generated Verus checker that replays supported exact pointwise integer and compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG formulas from compiler-derived coordinates, domains, preconditions, and values; no generic relation premise supplies equality. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity, while a private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports. Status-Checked policy staging grants no authority. Canonical positive-step loops carry termination evidence only when the backedge update is statically nonwrapping; concrete nontermination is Rejected and an unsupported ranking proof is Incomplete. Dynamic slice reads are complete only for exact identical symbolic ranked extents or overflow-checked bounded static affine intervals; unrelated independent lengths, missing assertions, unsafe intervals, and overflow fail closed. Identical live typed floating-point trees receive an exact-zero error certificate; reassociation, changed operation order, and nonzero ErrorBounded replay remain unsupported. A tensor reference must name the exact propagated accumulator result root and match its component count and semantic scalar before value/store refinement can pass. This composes the target-owned physical layout proof with the safe Rust/Verus semantic obligation; the reference is not treated as a hardware-layout oracle. mi300x lacks the fixed retained /opt runtime, so no referenced production compile has completed this gate and there is no fallback. Compiler extraction/projection and analysis-result or transformation soundness, target IEEE values, LLVM-or-later lowering, target instruction arithmetic, artifacts, launch, hardware, and performance remain outside the claim.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: Archived pinned runs emitted gfx942 LLVM, linked HSACO, and compared selected kernel outputs with independent CPU references; those records remain historical evidence only. The current production architecture retains target-finalization components behind the sole Worker V3 application path, but this unpinned compiler state has no completed source-to-machine authority or current tutorial launch command. Protected publication, load, dispatch, numerical refinement, and complete compiler refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: Pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, and typed lifecycle foundations are present. The direct-KFD semantic observation boundary exposes only bounded queue-lifecycle and resource facts and does not dispatch work. Current production publication and load custody target the sole Worker V3 application path, which is not yet a completed launch or persistent-execution authority. Issues #135 and #137 track verified persistent execution and complete production runtime authority.

capabilities.label: Semantic debugging and profiling
capabilities.detail: Versioned semantic trace records, deterministic bounded hierarchy queries, and import boundaries establish an agent-readable foundation. The importer can retain selected rocprofv3 JSON dispatch-envelope and timing observations, ATT manifest metadata without decoded events, and sparse normalized ROCgdb records with explicit unavailable fields. There is no debugger or profiler UI, general source/MIR/KIR/ISA map, counter or PC-sample ingestion, ATT decoding, structured ROCgdb state, capture comparison, or diagnosis authority yet. Issue #215 tracks those layers.

capabilities.label: Historical CPU semantic simulation
capabilities.detail: The bounded CPU KIR executor and semantic-trace libraries remain as nonproduction components, but current main removed the alternate source-first cargo fe2o3 simulate route and its fixtures. This preserves one source collection and production compilation architecture. The website retains the exact historical scalar experiment as archived evidence at its original commit; it is not a current command, fallback, race-freedom proof, source-to-KIR or GPU equivalence theorem, launch authority, timing result, or performance prediction. A future no-GPU experience must join the single production pipeline rather than recreate an alternate compiler route; issue #216 tracks that work.
